lighthouse.label: Lighthouse
lighthouse.continent_help: Continent is stored for compatibility. Measurements run from the instance location.
lighthouse.thresholds_help: Empty thresholds are disabled. A drop of at least 10 points still warns. Unknown settings are preserved but not used.
lighthouse.headers_help: Check headers override site crawler headers with the same name.
lighthouse.warning: Lighthouse scores are below a threshold or dropped by at least 10 points.
lighthouse.succeeded: Lighthouse scores meet the configured thresholds.
lighthouse.busy: Lighthouse was busy; the audit did not run
lighthouse.mail_no_current_scores: The check could not run, so there are no current scores.
lighthouse.mail_recorded_thresholds: Thresholds are shown only where retained with this observation.
lighthouse.cause.audit_budget_exceeded: The page took longer than :seconds s to audit
lighthouse.cause.page_hung: The page stopped responding while loading
lighthouse.cause.page_crashed: The page crashed the browser during the audit
lighthouse.cause.no_content: The page did not display any content
lighthouse.cause.not_html: The address does not return an HTML page
lighthouse.cause.page_load_failed: The page could not be loaded
lighthouse.cause.report_unscored: Lighthouse could not score the page
lighthouse.cause.report_too_large: The page's Lighthouse report exceeds 8 MiB
lighthouse.cause.service_unavailable: The Lighthouse service could not be reached
lighthouse.cause.scope_release_failed: The Lighthouse service could not release its proxy scope
lighthouse.load_timed_out: The page loaded too slowly; scores may be incomplete.
lighthouse.presentation.load_timed_out: Page loaded too slowly; scores may be incomplete
